content:
UP PGT Final Result With Institute Allotment List 2026 – Link Active ✅

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Final Result and related Institute Allotment / Institution Location updates for the UP PGT examination (Advt. No. 01/2022 & 02/2022).

PGT interview was held from 15 – 27 June 2026. Final Result was published around 07 July 2026; Institute Allotment List is now active for candidates to check allotted schools/institutions.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start : 09 June 2022
  • Registration Last Date : 10 July 2022
  • Form Submit Last Date : 16 July 2022
  • PGT Exam Date : 09–10 May 2026
  • TGT Exam Date : 03–04 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 06 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 12 May 2026
  • PGT Result Date : 02 June 2026
  • Interview Letter : 05 June 2026
  • Interview Date : 15 – 27 June 2026
  • Final Result : 07 July 2026 – Available Now
  • Institute Allotment List : Available / Link Active

Application Fee (reference)

  • Gen / OBC : ₹750/-
  • EWS : ₹650/-
  • SC : ₹450/-
  • ST : ₹250/-
  • PH : ₹375/-

Eligibility (brief)

  • TGT : Bachelor’s Degree in relevant subject + B.Ed.
  • PGT : Master’s Degree in relevant subject (subject-wise rules apply)

Selection Process

  1. Written Examination
  2. Interview
  3. Final Result
  4. Institute Allotment

How to Check Final Result & Institute Allotment

  1. Visit https://www.upessc.up.gov.in/
  2. Open PGT Final Result / Institution Location / allotment news links
  3. For login result: use https://www.upessc.net/pgt2022results/Login.aspx
  4. Enter Registration Number, Date of Birth and Captcha
  5. Download result / check allotted institute
  6. Keep printout for joining process

Always verify final result and allotment only from official UPESSC website upessc.up.gov.in.
